subject: ENGLISH
descriptionUz: Multilevel yo'lidagi birinchi jiddiy bosqich: Present Simple, kundalik mavzular, asosiy so'z boyligi. Har dars nazariya (o'zbekcha tushuntirish), misollar va interaktiv mashqlardan iborat.

modules.titleUz: Grammatika asoslari I: to be va Present Simple

objectivesUz: To be bilan darak, inkor va so'roq gaplar tuzish

content.bodyUz:
Ingliz tilida «to be» (bo'lmoq) — eng ko'p ishlatiladigan fe'l. O'zbek tilida biz «Men talabaman» deymiz — «man» qo'shimchasi vazifasini ingliz tilida **am/is/are** bajaradi.

- **I am** — men ...man
- **He/She/It is** — u ...dir
- **We/You/They are** — biz/siz/ular ...miz/siz/lar

**Inkor:** be dan keyin **not** qo'shiladi: *I am not tired. She isn't a teacher.*

**So'roq:** be gapning boshiga chiqadi: *Are you ready? Is he at home?*

Qisqa javoblar: *Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. / Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.*
Imtihonda eng ko'p uchraydigan xato: «He are», «They is». Egani aniqlab oling: birlikmi (is) yoki ko'plikmi (are)? «I» esa doim «am» bilan!

exercises.explanationUz: «My brother» — u (birlik, 3-shaxs), shuning uchun «is» ishlatiladi.
«You» bilan doim «are» ishlatiladi: Are you...?
«I» bilan faqat «am» ishlatiladi.
«They» ko'plik, shuning uchun «are» kerak: They are my friends.
To'g'ri tartib: My sister is a nurse. (Ega + fe'l + kesim)

content.bodyUz:
Present Simple — **odatiy, takrorlanadigan** ish-harakatlar va **umumiy haqiqatlar** uchun ishlatiladi:

- Odatlar: *I drink tea every morning.* (Har kuni choy ichaman)
- Jadval: *The lesson starts at 9.* (Dars 9 da boshlanadi)
- Haqiqatlar: *Water boils at 100°C.*

Signal so'zlar: **every day, always, usually, often, sometimes, never**

3-shaxs birlikda (he, she, it) fe'lga **-s** qo'shiladi:

- I work → He work**s**
- We play → She play**s**

Maxsus holatlar:
- -o, -sh, -ch, -ss, -x bilan tugasa → **-es**: go → go**es**, watch → watch**es**
- undosh + y bilan tugasa → **-ies**: study → stud**ies**
- have → **has** (istisno!)

items.en: My father watches the news every evening.
items.uz: Otam har kuni kechqurun yangiliklarni ko'radi.

content.bodyUz: Multilevel imtihonining Listening va Reading qismlarida Present Simple eng ko'p uchraydigan zamon. «-s» ni unutish — writingda ham eng keng tarqalgan xato. «He/She/It — s bilan do'st» deb yodlab oling!

data.text: My mother ___ delicious plov every Sunday.

exercises.explanationUz: «My mother» = she → fe'lga -s qo'shiladi: cooks.

«have» 3-shaxs birlikda «has» bo'ladi — istisno fe'l.

exercises.explanationUz: I/They — asos shakl; my sister/the dog (he-she-it) — fe'l + s.

content.bodyUz:
Present Simple'da inkor uchun yordamchi fe'l kerak:

- I/You/We/They + **don't** + fe'l: *I don't like coffee.*
- He/She/It + **doesn't** + fe'l: *She doesn't work here.*

⚠️ MUHIM: doesn't dan keyin fe'l **asos shaklda** qoladi (-s YO'Q!):
❌ *She doesn't works* → ✅ *She doesn't work*

- **Do** I/you/we/they + fe'l? — *Do you speak English?*
- **Does** he/she/it + fe'l? — *Does he play football?*

Qisqa javoblar: *Yes, I do. / No, I don't. / Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.*

Wh- savollar: *Where do you live? What time does the shop open?*

content.bodyUz:
**Dilnoza's Day**

Dilnoza is a nurse at a big hospital in Andijan. She wakes up at 5:30 every morning and does exercise for twenty minutes. After breakfast, she goes to work by bus because she doesn't have a car. Her shift starts at 8:00 and finishes at 16:00. In the evening, she studies English for one hour because she wants to work abroad in the future. She usually goes to bed at 22:30.
True/False savollarida matndagi RAQAMLAR va INKOR so'zlarga (doesn't, never) alohida e'tibor bering — tuzoqlar odatda shu yerda bo'ladi.

modules.titleUz: Grammatika asoslari II: o'tgan va hozirgi davom zamon

objectivesUz: Present Simple va Present Continuous farqini ajratish

content.bodyUz:
Present Continuous — **hozir, shu daqiqada** bo'layotgan ish-harakat uchun ishlatiladi:

**am/is/are + fe'l + -ing**

- *I am reading now.* — Men hozir o'qiyapman.
- *She is cooking.* — U ovqat pishiryapti.
- *They are playing football.* — Ular futbol o'ynashyapti.

Signal so'zlar: **now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!**

- Oddiy holat: work → work**ing**, play → play**ing**
- Fe'l **-e** bilan tugasa, e tushib qoladi: make → mak**ing**, write → writ**ing**
- Qisqa unli + undosh bo'lsa, undosh ikkilanadi: run → ru**nn**ing, sit → si**tt**ing, swim → swi**mm**ing
- **-ie** bilan tugasa → **-ying**: lie → l**ying**

items.en: I am doing my homework at the moment.
My mother is making samsa in the kitchen.
They aren't watching TV, they are studying.

lessons.titleUz: Past Simple: to'g'ri fe'llar (-ed) va was/were
objectivesUz: didn't va Did bilan inkor-so'roq gap tuzish

content.bodyUz:
«To be» fe'lining o'tgan zamoni ikki shaklga ega:

- **I/He/She/It + was**: *I was at home yesterday.* — Kecha uyda edim.
- **We/You/They + were**: *They were tired.* — Ular charchagan edi.

Inkor: **wasn't / weren't**. So'roq: *Was he at school? Were you busy?*

Signal so'zlar: **yesterday, last week, two days ago, in 2020**

O'tgan zamonda to'g'ri fe'llarga **-ed** qo'shiladi va bu shakl BARCHA shaxslar uchun bir xil:

*I worked. She worked. They worked.*

Diqqat: o'tgan zamonda 3-shaxs uchun -s qo'shilmaydi!

items.en: I watched an interesting film yesterday.
She was at home last night.
We visited our grandparents last week.
They weren't at school two days ago.

content.bodyUz:
- Inkor: **didn't + fe'l (asos shakl)**: *I didn't work yesterday.*
- So'roq: **Did + ega + fe'l?**: *Did you watch the match?*

⚠️ didn't/Did dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklda qoladi:
❌ *She didn't worked* → ✅ *She didn't work*
«yesterday», «last ...», «... ago» so'zlarini ko'rsangiz — bu Past Simple! «ago» doim davr oxirida turadi: two years ago (ikki yil oldin).

content.bodyUz:
Ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p ishlatiladigan fe'llarning aksariyati **noto'g'ri**: ularga -ed qo'shilmaydi, shakli butunlay o'zgaradi:

- go → **went** (bordi)
- buy → **bought** (sotib oldi)

Ularni yodlashdan boshqa yo'l yo'q — lekin xavotir olmang: quyidagi 25 tasi bilan kundalik gaplarning 90% ini qura olasiz.

content.bodyUz:
Noto'g'ri fe'llarda ham inkor va so'roq **did** bilan tuziladi, fe'l esa asos shaklga qaytadi:

- ✅ *I didn't go to work.* ❌ *I didn't went*
- ✅ *Did you see the match?* ❌ *Did you saw...?*

V2 shakl faqat DARAK gapda ishlatiladi: *I went home.*

Har kuni 5 tadan fe'l yodlang va ular bilan o'zingiz haqingizda gap tuzing: «Yesterday I got up at 7, drank tea, went to work...». Diqqat: «read» ning o'tgan shakli ham «read» deb yoziladi, lekin [red] deb o'qiladi!

content.titleUz: Artikl nima va nega bizga qiyin?
content.bodyUz:
O'zbek tilida artikl YO'Q — shuning uchun bu mavzu bizga g'alati tuyuladi. Ingliz tilida esa deyarli har bir otning oldida artikl turadi:

- **a/an** — noaniq artikl: «qandaydir bitta» — *a book* (bitta, qaysidir kitob)
- **the** — aniq artikl: «o'sha, ma'lum» — *the book* (siz bilgan o'sha kitob)

O'zbekchada «bitta» va «o'sha/haligi» so'zlari taxminan shu vazifani bajaradi: *Menga bitta kitob ber* (a book) / *Haligi kitobni ber* (the book).

Keyingi so'z qanday TOVUSH bilan boshlanishiga qarang (harfga emas!):

- Undosh tovush → **a**: *a book, a table, a university* [yu — undosh tovush!]
- Unli tovush → **an**: *an apple, an egg, an hour* [h o'qilmaydi!]

a/an faqat SANALADIGAN BIRLIK otlar bilan ishlatiladi: *a car* ✅, *a water* ❌, *a cars* ❌

**The** — suhbatdoshingiz QAYSI narsa haqida gap ketayotganini bilsa:

1. Ikkinchi marta tilga olinganda: *I saw a cat. The cat was black.*
2. Dunyoda yagona narsalar: *the sun, the moon, the Internet*
3. Musiqa asboblari: *play the piano, play the guitar*
4. Ikkalangiz ham biladigan narsa: *Open the window* (xonadagi o'sha deraza)

content.bodyUz:
Notanish odamdan biror narsa so'rashdan oldin **Excuse me** (kechirasiz) deyiladi:

- *Excuse me, where is the bank?* — Kechirasiz, bank qayerda?
- *How can I get to the station?* — Vokzalga qanday borsam bo'ladi?
- *Is there a pharmacy near here?* — Bu yaqin atrofda dorixona bormi?

Narx so'rash:

- *I'm just looking, thanks.* — Shunchaki ko'ryapman, rahmat.

content.bodyUz:
*What time is it?* — Soat necha bo'ldi?

- 3:00 — *It's three o'clock.*
- 3:15 — *It's quarter past three.* (uchdan o'n besh daqiqa o'tdi)
- 3:30 — *It's half past three.* (yarim to'rt)
- 3:45 — *It's quarter to four.* (to'rtga chorak qoldi)

Osonroq usul — raqamlab o'qish: 3:15 = *three fifteen*, 3:45 = *three forty-five*.

Vaqt bilan **at** predlogi ishlatiladi: *The lesson starts at 9:00.*

content.bodyUz:
*When is your birthday?* — Tug'ilgan kuningiz qachon?
*It's on the 5th of May.* / *It's on May 5th.*

Sanalarda tartib sonlar ishlatiladi: 1st (first), 2nd (second), 3rd (third), 4th (fourth), 21st (twenty-first)...

Predloglar xaritasi:
- **at** + soat: *at 6 o'clock*
- **on** + kun/sana: *on Monday, on 21 March*
- **in** + oy/yil: *in March, in 2026*

**Yoshlik Culture Centre — March Programme**

• **Navruz Holiday Concert** — Saturday, 21 March, 18:00. Main Hall. Tickets: 50,000 soums (students: 25,000 soums).

• **English Film Club** — every Wednesday, 17:30. Room 14. Free entrance.

• **Spring Book Fair** — 9–11 March, 10:00–19:00. Ground floor.

The ticket office is open Monday to Saturday, 9:00–18:00. It is closed on Sundays.
Afisha va jadval matnlarida avval SAVOLNI o'qing, keyin matndan raqam, kun va soatlarni skanerlang. «free» (bepul), «closed» (yopiq), «every» (har) kabi kichik so'zlar odatda javobni hal qiladi.

objectivesUz: I'd like... / Can I have...? bilan muloyim buyurtma berish
Ofitsiant savollarini tushunish va javob berish
Sevimli taom haqida 5-6 gap ayta olish

content.bodyUz:
Muloyim buyurtma uchun ikkita asosiy qolip:

- **Can I have ..., please?** — ... berasizmi, iltimos?
- **I'd like ...** (= I would like) — Men ... olmoqchiman.

❌ *I want tea* — juda qo'pol eshitiladi. ✅ *I'd like some tea, please.*

Ofitsiant savollari:
- *Are you ready to order?* — Buyurtma berishga tayyormisiz?
- *Anything to drink?* — Ichishga biror narsa?
- *Anything else?* — Yana biror narsa?
